title: tabernaemontana chippii
intro: Tabernaemontana chippii, commonly known as the Yellow Mandrake, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana chippii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
